summary: Added nightwatch lesson maintenance by implementing pruneAndCondenseLessons() in src/cron/nightwatch.ts and wiring it into runNightwatch so it runs every enabled cycle. The new flow groups persisted lessons by workingDir, sends each group to a read-only Claude subprocess with Codex fallback for condensation, caps outputs at 25 lessons, applies updates via removeLessons()+addLesson(), preserves runId/source from the most recent contributing lesson using sourceLessonIds provenance, logs per-group and aggregate pruned/merged counts, and skips groups on CLI failure without blocking the cycle. Verification: pnpm build, pnpm lint, pnpm vitest run src/cron/nightwatch.test.ts.
